title: „Space-E-Infect-Diagnosis of respiratory infections with the technology of the Electronic Nose and the combination of AI”
summary: Acute respiratory infections are common infections, but distinguishing between viral and bacterial infection is often challenging. Though antibiotics are effectively acting against bacterial infections, they are often prescribed also for viral infection. This mainly due the lack of safe and reliable diagnostics. By analyzing exhaled breath, we aim to investigate an easy, cheep, non-invasive and fast diagnostic alternative.

interventions.name:
Patients 3 years and older with an acute respiratory infection who are admitted the emergency room at the LMU-Hospital
Sample: Exhaled breath samples

Healthy subjects 3 years and older
Sample: Exhaled breath samples

Patients with a tracheostoma who are 3 years of age and older and have an appointment at the tracheostoma outpatient clinic
Sample: Exhaled breath samples

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- age greater than 3 years
- Patients with suspected acute respiratory infection
- Healthy control subjects
- Patients greater than 3 years with a tracheostoma
Exclusion criteria:
- Pregnancy
-Age younger than 3 years
